children.value: > Fact From Story The cheapest season ticket for Inter Miami in 2024 is $867, which works out to $51 per match across the 17 home games in the upcoming MLS season.

> > Fact From Story Orlando City SC, one of Inter Miami's chief in-state rivals, have their cheapest season ticket available for just $324 in 2024, over half the cost of any Inter Miami season ticket.
> > > Fact From Story These prices also dwarf many other clubs in Major League Soccer.
> > > Fact From Story Atlanta United, will feature its cheapest season ticket for $605 in 2024, or just $525 for founding members.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge If a ticket price is more than double the price of a similar alternative, then it is very expensive.
> > Fact From Story These prices also dwarf many other clubs in Major League Soccer.

> > > Fact From Story The National Football League (NFL), the most popular sport in the United States by a massive margin, boasted an average ticket price of $112 in 2022, while the average NBA ticket price was $94 that year.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge The NFL and NBA are popular sports leagues.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A ticket price is considered high if it is more expensive than similar alternatives.
> Commonsense Knowledge $51 per match is a high price for a ticket.
